रेव् रेव् or रेब्, cl. 1. A. रेवते, रेबते,
&c., to go, move, flow; to leap, jump, go
by leaps.

रेव, अस्, m., N. of a son of Ānarta and father of
Raivata; (आ), f., N. of the Narma-dā river (which
rises in one of the Vindhya mountains called Āmra-
kūṭa or more commonly Amarakantak in the province
of Gondwana, and after a westerly course of about
800 miles falls into the sea below Broach); the
indigo plant; N. of Rati (the wife of Kāma-deva);
(अम्), n., N. of various Sāmans.
—रेवोत्तरस् (˚वा-
उत्˚), आस्, m., Ved. a proper N.

रेवट, अस्, m. a boar; a bamboo cane; a whirl-
wind; a kind of poison; oil of the Morunga tree;
the fruit of the plantain; (अम्), n. a muscle or conch-
shell with its windings or spiral lines going from
right to left.
रेवण, अस्, m. a proper N.
रेवत् रे-वत्, रे-वती. See below and p. 854.

रे-वत्, आन्, अती, अत् (रे contracted fr. रयि + वत्),
having prosperity or wealth, rich, wealthy, opulent,
prosperous; grand in external appearance, shining,
[]
glittering, beautiful, illustrious; (अत्), ind., Ved. ra-
diantly, beautifully; (अती), f., N. of the fifth Nak-
ṣatra, (see नक्षत्र; sometimes also अत्यस्, f.
pl.); the day of Revatī; N. of the evil genius or
goddess presiding over a particular sickness, (some-
times identified with Durgā, sometimes with Aditi);
N. of the wife of Mitra; of a daughter of the Lustre
(कान्ति) of the Nakṣatra Revatī and mother of
Manu Raivata; of the wife of Bala-rāma (daughter
of Kakudmin); of a wife of Amṛtodana; (अत्यस्)
f. pl. ‘the wealthy ones, the shining ones,’ epithet
of cows (Ved.); waters, water, a quantity of water
(Ved.); epithet of the verse Ṛg-veda

(so
called from रेवती being the first word; the Raivata
Sāman is formed from this verse; according to Pāṇ.

. रेवती = one born under the
Nakṣatra Revatī); रेवद् याज्ञतुरम्, N. of a
Sāman.
—रेवती-भव, अस्, m. ‘son of Revatī,’
the planet Saturn.
—रेवती-रमण, अस्, m. the
husband of Revatī, i. e. Bala-rāma; N. of Viṣṇu.
—रेवतीश (˚ती-ईश), अस्, m. lord or husband of
Revatī, i. e. Bala-rāma.
—रेवती-सुत, अस्, m. ‘son
of Revatī,’ a N. of Skanda.

रेवत रेवत, अस्, m. the citron tree; Ca-
thartocarpus Fistula; N. of various persons; of a son
of Andhaka or of Ānarta; of the father of Revatī
and father-in-law of Bala-rāma; of a Varṣa (?) .

रेवतक, अस्, m. a proper N.; (अम्), n. a species
of plant.

रेवति, इस्, f., N. of Rati (wife of Kāma-deva);
= रे-वती, the wife of Bala-rāma.
—रेवति-पुत्र,
अस्, m. (रेवति for रेवती), the son of Revatī.
रेवत्य (a Vedic adjective fr. रेवती, Pāṇ.

रेवन्त, अस्, m., N. of a son of Sūrya and chief
of the Guhyakas; the fifth Manu of the present
Kalpa; [cf. रैवत.]
—रेवन्त-मनु-सू, ऊस्, f.
mother of Manu Revanta, epithet of Sañjñā (wife of
Sūrya).
—रेवन्तोत्तर (˚त-उत्˚), N. of a work.
